meta.pos: verb; verb; verb; verb; verb; noun; noun; noun

defs.def: to take a firm hold of sb/sth 抓紧；抓牢
to understand sth completely 理解；领会；领悟；明白

ex.s: Klein writes, "America did not invent the steam engine, but once they grasped its passwords they put it to more uses than anyone else. "
ex.t: Klein写道："美国人没有发明蒸汽机，但一旦他们掌握了它的奥秘，它的用途就比任何人都多。"

ex.s: Readers will encounter not only stories they have heard before, but some new stories and a moving discussion of the responsibility of the engineer to the public and the ways young engineers can be helped to grasp them.
ex.t: 读者不仅会读到他们以前听过的故事，还会读到一些新故事，以及关于工程师对公众的责任、以及如何帮助年轻工程师理解这些责任的感人讨论。

ex.s: But Smith was struck mainly by the fact that she didn't truly grasp any of the skills the author described.
ex.t: 尽管史密斯确实拿到了最好的沙子，但用传统方式做事不仅仅是在玩弄法国泥巴。

ex.s: Mostly “b” Hmm… whilst you seem to have grasped the basics of self-management, there is still room for improvement!
ex.t: 主要选"b" 嗯……虽然你似乎已经掌握了自我管理的基本知识，但仍有改进的空间！

ex.s: With many crafts having been, or about to be, lost forever, people are beginning to grasp the importance of preserving those that remain.
ex.t: 随着许多手工艺已经或即将永远失传，人们开始意识到保护那些留存下来的手工艺的重要性。

ex.s: B: Well, I suppose it was difficult to grasp the tones at first.
ex.t: B：嗯，我想一开始掌握声调是很难的。

ex.s: That way, my Chinese will improve much faster, especially my written Chinese, which I find the most difficult to grasp.
ex.t: 那样的话，我的中文会提高得更快，特别是书面语，这是我觉得最难掌握的。

defs.def: to take an opportunity without hesitating and use it 急忙抓住，毫不犹豫地抓住（机会）

ex.s: Now that Helen grasped the key to language, she was very eager to learn more and use it as much as she could.
ex.t: 既然海伦掌握了语言的关键，她非常渴望学更多，并尽可能多地使用它。

defs.def: to try to take hold of sth in your hands 尽力抓住某物
to try to take an opportunity 抓住机会
a firm hold of sb/sth or control over sb/sth 紧抓；紧握；控制
a person's understanding of a subject or of difficult facts 理解（力）；领会

ex.s: A grasp of how to manage color in your spaces is one of the first steps to creating rooms you’ll love to live in.
ex.t: 掌握如何在你空间中管理色彩的方法，是你创造自己喜欢的房间的第一步之一。

defs.def: the ability to get or achieve sth 能力所及

chunks.cn: 理解关键的 / 理解吨 / 理解基本的
理解怎样 / 理解技能
